legal.p.intro: This policy explains what OpenMeru Mail collects when you use a mailbox at openmeru.com, why, and what you can do about it.
legal.p.store1: Account data: your name, your @openmeru.com address, a hashed password, an optional recovery email, signature, profile photo and forwarding address.
legal.p.store2: Your mail: messages you send and receive, with their attachments, kept so you can read them in your mailbox.
legal.p.store3: Technical data: session cookies that keep you signed in, the date of your last sign-in, your language choice and, if you turn them on, the browser push subscription used for new-mail notifications.
legal.p.use: Only to run your mailbox: deliver and show your mail, send what you write, notify you of new messages, let you recover access and keep the service secure. We do not sell your data and we do not use your messages for advertising.
legal.p.who1: Our server provider hosts the application and the database.
legal.p.who2: Cloudflare receives incoming mail for openmeru.com and passes it to your mailbox.
legal.p.who3: Brevo relays the mail you send.
legal.p.who4: Your browser's push service (for example Google, Apple or Mozilla) delivers notifications if you enable them.
legal.p.private: A mailbox only shows its own messages. Administrators can manage accounts and may open a mailbox when that is needed to provide support or keep the service secure.
legal.p.keep: Your mail stays until you delete it. Messages in Trash can be deleted for good at any time. When an account is deleted, its messages, attachments and profile photo are removed.
legal.p.choice1: Edit your profile, change your password or set forwarding in Settings.
legal.p.choice2: Turn notifications on or off on each device.
legal.p.choice3: Delete your account and all its mail from Settings → Delete account.
legal.t.intro: These terms apply to every mailbox at openmeru.com provided by OpenMeru Mail. By signing in you accept them.
legal.t.account1: Keep your password private. You are responsible for what is sent from your mailbox.
legal.t.account2: Tell us at hello@openmeru.com if you think someone else has access to it.
legal.t.useLead: You must not use OpenMeru Mail to:
legal.t.use1: send spam, bulk unsolicited mail or phishing;
legal.t.use2: send malware or try to break into other systems or accounts;
legal.t.use3: harass, threaten or impersonate other people;
legal.t.use4: break the law or the rights of others.
legal.t.useEnd: We may limit, suspend or close a mailbox that breaks these rules.
legal.t.service: We work to keep OpenMeru Mail available and your mail safe, but the service is provided as it is. Delivery to other providers can be delayed or filtered by them. Keep your own copies of anything important.
legal.t.end: You can delete your account at any time in Settings → Delete account. This removes the mailbox and all its mail and cannot be undone.
legal.t.changes: We may update these terms. The date at the top shows the latest version.
demoBlocked: This is a demo, so changes aren't saved. Install OpenMeru on your own domain to use it for real.
